hook: Nearly one in ten Major League players was born in the Dominican Republic.
twist: MLB's 2026 Opening Day count: 93 Dominican-born players of 948, then Venezuela 60, Cuba 20, Canada 19. Per person, tiny Curaçao (4 players, about 156,000 people) beats the Dominican Republic three to one.
angle: Who supplies the Majors outside the US, by count and then per person, from MLB's own Opening Day release and World Bank populations.
why_now: The 2026 World Series runs from 23 October (Game 4 on 27 October, our slot); MLB published the birthplace count on 26 March 2026. US audience, highest ad rates. Demand evidence is thin: YouTube search 'countries with the most mlb players' (2026-10-07) found no Short on the exact topic above 0.4M ('Guess the top ten countries with the most NBA players' 0.40M); the pick rests on the World Series timing, not on a proven outlier.
risks: Counts are birthplaces of players on 2026 Opening Day rosters and inactive lists (pool 948), not nationality: say 'born in' and show the source.
Puerto Rico is a US territory and Curaçao a constituent country of the Kingdom of the Netherlands; MLB counts both as 'countries and territories'. Use 'places', not 'countries', for those two.
MLB revised its release (247 then 249 players; Canada 17 then 19); use the revised version.
